messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Error MS stats - Group Comparison
parts:
Dear Mirta,

It seems that the required formation for MSstats are not complete. It could have several reasons.

First, Have you done for annotation part? such as assign Run, Condition column. At the beginning of tutorial, it mentioned about it.
Second, MSstats report from Skyline itself could be the problem. If you are done for annotation, could you try below?
   1) file>export>report>MSstats input, then click 'export' button.
   2) 'MSstats input.csv' will be generated under the folder which has skyline file.
   3) could you go through the .csv file and check is there any empty cell?
   4) Then, could you send me the column names of MSstats input.csv or just capture first few rows?
Third, MSstats installation itself didn't complete yet.

I hope that it will be helpful for you.

Meena
